name: A Warmer Shade of Summer
source:
You return to the family farm to find it in disrepair. Maybe you have what it takes to bring it back to its former glory? Who knows who you'll meet on you're way? An old friend? That special someone? Anything is possible in Summerset.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
回到家族农场，你发现这里早已年久失修。也许，你有本事让它恢复昔日的荣光？又有谁知道，途中会遇见什么人呢？老朋友？命中注定的那个人？在萨默塞特，一切皆有可能。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639580/]Steam[/url]]
